pages.text: From the $(l)Outbreak$() the plague finds the villages. When a villager falls sick the bell rings and word goes out. The sick cough on their neighbours, shut their shops (a sick villager will not trade) and, in the worst stage, $(4)waste away and die$() unless treated. Their bodies rise as Afflicted.

pages.title: Weathered or fallen
pages.text: Half a day after the last villager recovers, the outbreak is over. If anyone is left alive the village has $(2)weathered$() it: whoever treated its people is a hero there, and gets a better price.$(br2)If no one is left the village has $(4)fallen$(): its doors are marked and a Plague Pit opens in its square.$(br2)From the $(l)Heralds$() on, some villages are found already fallen.
